title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: unified alert queue with Triage Agent categorisations
summary: Hold: neither the roadmap nor Microsoft's notice states that the queue has no charge. The usage monitoring dashboard also offers capacity changes, contrary to the briefing's statement that it cannot set a limit. The rollout facts and documented navigation are substantially supported, but the permissions discussion needs to preserve Microsoft's role-group qualifications.
